name: indexed_scale_shift
description: Per-row indexed affine transform with explicit bfloat16 rounding boundaries: idx=indices.long(); one=(1+scale[idx]).to(bfloat16).float(); v=(x.float()*one).to(bfloat16).float(); out=(v+shift[idx]).to(x.dtype). x is [rows,hidden], shift and scale are [variants,hidden], indices is [rows]; indices may be int32 or int64. Returns a new tensor shaped like x. Current tests exercise bfloat16 x/shift/scale with hidden 1024..3072 and int32 indices; inputs are read-only.
